name: Follow-up Note
description: An AI-assisted ambient scribe for orthopaedic follow-ups

sections.title: Patient Information
sections.instruction: Include only if explicitly stated: Name, Age, Gender, Address, Contact information.

sections.title: Chief Complaint (CC) or Follow-up Duration
sections.instruction: Primary reason for visit or duration of follow-up since last appointment. Required if mentioned.

sections.title: History of Present Illness (HPI)
sections.instruction: Chronological description of symptoms, onset, duration, severity, modifying factors, and pertinent context. For follow-up visits, focus only on interval changes since last visit.

sections.title: Review of Systems (ROS)
sections.instruction: Include only systems explicitly discussed and relevant to the chief complaint.

sections.title: Past Medical History (PMHx)
sections.instruction: Document only if specifically mentioned. Omit in follow-up visits unless discussed.

sections.title: Current Medications and Allergies
sections.instruction: List medications and allergies only if explicitly discussed. Omit in follow-up visits unless changes or discussion occurred.

sections.title: Family and Social History
sections.instruction: Include only if explicitly mentioned. Omit in follow-up visits unless discussed.

sections.title: Physical Examination Findings
sections.instruction: Objective clinical findings organized by system as documented.

sections.title: Laboratory/Imaging Results
sections.instruction: Include only if results are explicitly provided.

sections.title: Assessment
sections.instruction: Primary diagnosis and/or differential diagnoses, clinical reasoning, interpretation of findings, and status of conditions. Include only if documented.

sections.title: Plan
sections.instruction: Include only if future actions are explicitly mentioned: ordered tests/procedures, prescribed medications/treatments, referrals/consultations, follow-up instructions, and patient education.
